purpose.text: Per ACTIVE scheduled lane: expected slots (config/lane_registry.json) vs dispatcher runs (n8n coordination ledger) -> 24 h expected/done/late/missed/failed, last expected slot, last RUN_DONE, output-signal age and one state with its cause; plus the Home v010 Schedulers rollup (OK/WARN/UNKNOWN). Registration is not execution: an n8n slot with no ledger run is MISSED. Cron/systemd lanes have no per-run ledger: NOT_MEASURED, never 0.
purpose.business_function: Home v010 Schedulers row (late/missed per lane)

healthy.text: a shadow dry run prints the Schedulers rollup and one row count, exits 0, writes nothing
once promoted, lane_health_current.measured_at advances at least every 10 minutes

degraded.text: promoted lane: lane_health_current.measured_at older than 20 minutes

failed.text: the table is missing (exit 1, no DDL), the DB write fails (exit 1, mirror db_written=false), or --apply without TRADEAI_RUN_ID (exit 2)
the run is killed at timeout_s 120

baseline.freshness_rule: promoted lane: degraded beyond 20 min without a table refresh, failed beyond 30 min (the spec's 0.5 h contract)
baseline.source: NOT_MEASURED for the dispatcher (never dispatched). A read-only dry run against the production ledger (39,499 runs, 739 registry rows) took about 1.3 s wall on the host.
